items.exampleEn: Clean water is precious in the desert.
items.exampleZh: 在沙漠裡，乾淨的水非常珍貴。

我們聞得到燃燒的木頭味。

items.exampleEn: Close the bottle tightly after you use it.
items.exampleZh: 用完後把瓶子緊緊地蓋好。

items.exampleEn: The light from the old lamp was faint.

items.sentenceEn: My old bike is too heavy for steep hills.
items.sentenceZh: 我的舊腳踏車太重，騎不上陡坡。

items.audioEn: Tie your shoes tightly before the race starts.

options: Run as fast as you can

items.sentenceZh: 和家人相處的時間很珍貴。

items.sentenceEn: She had a hidden talent for singing.
items.sentenceZh: 她有不為人知的唱歌天分。

items.stemEn: Be careful! The pan is still ____ hot.
This necklace was my grandmother's, so it is very ____ to me.
items.stemZh: 這條項鍊是我奶奶的，所以對我來說非常珍貴。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, my cousin and I made a bold plan: to find a hidden waterfall that few people know about. The path was so steep that we had to hold onto the trees tightly. After two hours, we heard the faint sound of water. Then we saw it: the waterfall was beautiful, and the water shone in the burning sun. My cousin, who loves art, said the rocks looked like an abstract painting. We stayed there for an hour. On the way back, we had a scary encounter with a snake. These are precious memories for me.
items.passageZh: 上週日，我和我的表親擬了一個大膽的計畫：去找一座很少人知道的隱藏瀑布。小路非常陡，我們必須緊緊抓住樹木。兩個小時後，我們聽到微弱的水聲。接著我們就看到了：瀑布很美，水在灼熱的陽光下閃閃發亮。熱愛藝術的表親說，那些岩石看起來像一幅抽象畫。我們在那裡待了一個小時。回程時，我們遇到一條蛇，嚇了一大跳。這些對我來說都是珍貴的回憶。

questions.questionZh: 他們怎麼知道瀑布就在附近？
options: 看到路邊有一個很大的指示牌
在路上碰到一條蛇，被嚇到了
作者的表親在路上滑倒受傷了
他們迷路了好幾個小時
